resolution.note: lane usage header names finish; command-table test pins every dispatched verb in the header

title: krn lane prints every verb including finish in its usage header
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: `krn lane --help` first line reads 'Usage: krn lane start|run|drop|brief' while src/cli/lane.ts:331 dispatches finish (#1200).
Outcome: the usage header names finish beside start, run, drop and brief.
Why: a lead reading the header misses the recovery verb for a dead lane.
Proof: node --test test/cli/lane.test.ts asserts the header lists finish.
Files: src/cli/lane.ts
